facts.business: Bharat Wire Ropes Limited is a leading steel wire rope manufacturing company established in 1986, producing wire ropes, slings, and spiral strands for diverse applications including construction, mining, oil & gas, ports, elevators, and defence.
key_risks: Geopolitical instability and war in Middle East disrupting logistics (Strait of Hormuz)
Volatile commodity prices and sticky inflation
Elevated crude oil prices pressuring import bill and inflation
High borrowing costs due to RBI's cautious stance
Revenue recognition risks related to discounts, rebates, and incentives
Recoverability of PSI receivables from government authorities (INR 12,857.58 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026)
